Anemia is present (Hb 11 g/dL) with a positive direct antiglobulin test, indicating autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA), a known complication of CLL. Confirmation would be with flow cytometry showing a monoclonal B-cell population (CD19+, CD5+, CD23+), and further staging/genetic testing would guide management.

DIAGNOSIS: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) presenting with autoimmune (DAT-positive) hemolytic anemia.
